judgement.reason: Grist documents are SQLite files on local disk, but grist-core supports S3 external document storage with PostgreSQL for home data, so the outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (GRIST_DATA_DIR=/persist/docs (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: Grist keeps its documents as SQLite files under GRIST_DATA_DIR, and none of the shown lines points that data at S3 or a managed database, so the persistent-disk need stands.
